profile.headline: Technical Lead Software Enginee at Garmin International
profile.summary:
More than 9 years of experience in software development. Extensive experience in complete project life cycle from inception to release. Projects include production, research driven , performance or quality improvement of existing system, rapid prototype development,reengineering, etc.

Graduate research: http://gradworks.umi.com/14/87/1487618.html (details in education section)

Specialties: C, C++, Java, C#. OOD, OOA, multithreaded applications, design patterns, REST web services, algorithms development, embedded applications

Patients: 
- US 8175801 B2 : Link promotion method and apparatus for improving route search performance for navigation system
- US 20100169007 A1: Method and apparatus for navigation system for detecting and warning traffic rule violation

positions.title: Software/Firmware engineer
positions.description: Software/Firmware engineer in medical device development.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sr software engineer in research division. Involved in various research and development projects.

Extensive involvement in algorithm development, high level and low level designing and coding in object oriented languages such as C++,C# and Java. 
Extensive experience in OOA/OOD and various design patterns. 

REST web services using WCF .net, Java JAX-RS Jersey and PHP, Embedded development in custom as well as commercial operating systems such as WinCE. Ample experience in performance driven, multi-threaded systems.    

Good exposure to  Android development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and development of embedded vehicle tracking devices firmware.

Developed around 6 versions of tracking devices for cars, school busses, fire trucks, police cars etc. Software developed in C and C++.

Involved in development of many wireless devices like RIM, ENFORA, KENWOOD RADIO, MOTOROLA RADIO etc.
Extensive development in custom embedded systems.

Developed firmware updating protocol for embedded system. Involved in creating and modifying modules of operating system development.

positions.title: Software engineer
positions.description:
C++ software engineer. 
Designed and developed a script interpreter for CAD-CAM software. 
This interpreter is used to run scrip that can be useful to users for rapid drawing of the PC board circuit in the software.
